verdicts.reason: Both candidates look the same. Each is a squeezed 320x50 copy rather than a real rearrangement: the sun logo and 'SOLSTICE' wordmark have shrunk to an unreadable speck. The headline 'Chase the light' runs into the Shop Now button, so the 't' almost touches the pill, and the subline is close to too small to read. The left side has a dead gap while the right side is crammed.
